content: Simethicone is a medication prescribed to alleviate symptoms associated with excessive gas in the gastrointestinal tract. These symptoms may include uncomfortable or painful pressure, a sensation of fullness, and bloating. In some cases, simethicone may be prescribed for other uses; consult your doctor or pharmacist for additional information. Simethicone is available in various forms, including regular tablets, chewable tablets, capsules, and liquid, all of which are intended for oral administration. It is typically taken four times a day, following meals and at bedtime. It is essential to follow the instructions provided on the packaging or your prescription label carefully. If you have any questions or require clarification, consult your doctor or pharmacist. Take simethicone exactly as directed, without exceeding or reducing the prescribed dose or frequency. Regular tablets and capsules should be swallowed whole, while chewable tablets must be thoroughly chewed before swallowing. Do not swallow chewable tablets whole. Unless otherwise instructed by your doctor, do not exceed six simethicone tablets or eight simethicone capsules per day. The liquid form of simethicone may be mixed with one ounce of cool water or infant formula before administration. Before taking simethicone, inform your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to simethicone or any other medications. Additionally, provide a complete list of all prescription and nonprescription medications you are currently taking, including vitamins. Notify your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. If you become pregnant while taking simethicone, contact your doctor immediately. If you are taking simethicone on a regular schedule and miss a dose, take the missed dose as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not take a double dose to compensate for a missed one. When used as directed, simethicone is generally well-tolerated and does not typically cause side effects. Store simethicone in its original container, ensuring it is tightly closed and kept out of reach of children. Maintain storage at room temperature, away from excessive heat and moisture. Avoid storing the medication in the bathroom. Dispose of any expired or no longer needed medication properly. Consult your pharmacist for guidance on the appropriate disposal of unused medication. If you have any questions or concerns about taking simethicone, do not hesitate to ask your doctor or pharmacist for further information.
